theme: Shaadi Season (and a Very Black Friday)

segments.title: November
segments.text: Hello Kemps Corner! November is Shaadi Season, and a very Black Friday. Half our members have a wedding to dance at, and the other half have a sale to wait for. We have something for both.

segments.title: ₹21.4L
segments.text: So, the number. Our November target for Kemps Corner is 21.4 lakh rupees. That's 16 per cent above last November. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 11.8 lakh rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 5.14 lakh, comebacks 2.57 lakh, and everything else 1.93 lakh. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 46 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 335 leads, 171 trials, and 46 buyers, with about 27 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.
Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 13.8 lakh rupees, which is 64 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: 11.11: Treat Yourself, Not Your Ex
segments.text: First up, eleven eleven: treat yourself, not your ex. Eleven hours only, eight-class packs at twenty per cent off. One per person. The plan is 10 buyers at about 10,500, so 1.05 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Everyone: newcomers, pack buyers and members.

segments.title: Bride Squad, Assemble (Groom Can Come Too)
segments.text: Next, Bride Squad, Assemble. The groom can come too. Four or more of you, at least two new, buy twelve-class packs together at twelve per cent off and get a private Squad Class that ends on a Sangeet routine. The plan is 18 buyers at about 17,300, so 3.12 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Wedding parties and friend groups (min 4, at least 2 new).

segments.title: Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana (Come Back Before the Baraat)
segments.text: Then, for lapsed members, Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana. Fifteen per cent off to come back, matching Bride Tribe socks, and a seat at the Sangeet Choreo Barre. The plan is 8 buyers at about 17,200, so 1.38 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Black Friday Blind Box (No Duds)
segments.text: And finally, the Black Friday Blind Box. No duds. Renew for three, six or twelve months and pick a sealed box: extra days, guest passes, a private. Every box wins, and one annual box per studio hides the hoodie. The plan is 11 buyers at about 75,000, so 8.25 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members renewing or upgrading; annual renewers due Nov–Jan.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, bride squads and wedding parties get their group rate. Week two, eleven eleven: eleven hours of pack prices, and no exes invited. Week three, the Sangeet Choreo Barre on the twentieth, and lapsed members come back before the baraat. Week four, the Black Friday Blind Box, four days, long plans only, and no duds.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's November at Kemps Corner. 21.4 lakh rupees, four offers, and 46 buyers to welcome. Wedding-ready and fully booked. That's November.
segments.signoff: Wedding-ready and fully booked. That's November.
